base.commit_note: the commit that gave the base its views/; the diff is measured against that state

difference.implementation_note: the inlet velocity vector is rotated 2 deg; the geometry and the mesh are untouched, so every changed pixel is flow and not silhouette

view_contract.body_fill: magenta solid, a colour the colormap cannot produce
view_contract.range_note: union over both cases, not the range of either alone, and clamped rather than clipped

pipeline.crop: the top 56 rows carry the burned title, which differs between cases
pipeline.mask: every non grey pixel in either frame, which removes the magenta body and its antialiased edge
pipeline.instrument_recipe: the grayscale renders are the instrument and stay outside the capsule, SPEC 4.7. Regenerate them by re-exporting each view with colormap grayscale and every other setting of view_contract unchanged, then crop 56 rows.

pairs.name: diff_cp_nearfield
pairs.question: where does the pressure field change with two degrees more incidence

pairs.name: diff_u_over_u_wake
pairs.question: where does the velocity field change and how far downstream does it persist

scalar_deltas.note: two degrees raise total drag by 15 percent, pressure drag by 51 percent, and lower friction drag by 3 percent. A single drag scalar would hide that split.

known_differences: the far field partition of the variant is rotated 2 deg with the freestream, so that the inlet and outlet halves stay aligned with the flow. Leaving it perpendicular admitted inflow through the pressure outlet and moved pressure drag by 8 percent without any monitor complaining.
wake_refine is aligned with the wake of the base, so the wake of the variant leaves that refined band further downstream

cp_stagnation of the variant is 1.00071, above the incompressible bound of 1. Measured at residuals of 2.5e-9, so it is structural and not convergence noise. 26 percent is attributed to the pressure datum measured at the inlet, 0.0249 Pa; the remainder is unattributed between discrete stagnation point resolution and finite domain.
the base ran 2285 iterations and the variant 2567. Both stopped on the asymptotic monitor criteria, not on an iteration cap.
both cases ran in double precision on 2606. An earlier pass in single precision gave changed pixel fractions of 6.47 and 6.14 percent: the rounding floor pushed pixels just past the threshold.
